verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs explicitly describe launching 'fleets of agents that work in parallel on ambitious tasks for hours or days' and setting up always-on agents on schedules/triggers, all accessible from Cursor's interface spanning terminal, Slack, and GitHub — directly matching a unified multi-session agent workspace for a lead overseeing parallel work. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the multi-agent dashboard UX, and no detail on cross-session visibility/coordination features specifically framed for engineering-lead oversight.
